criteria.criterion: A fresh temporary repository follows the worked example from default-shell doctor warning through config set platforms and shell, doctor pass or machine warning, each exact override refusal and invalid-value exit 2.
criteria.evidence: cmd/vloop/b40_mixed_os_test.go:26-70 drives init, config, doctor, all exact shell/platform override refusals, and invalid platforms through the CLI with the required exit codes and messages.

criteria.criterion: The end-to-end coverage proves vloop config get platforms prints the stored order, while doctor and errors print deduplicated sorted platforms.
criteria.evidence: cmd/vloop/b40_mixed_os_test.go:42-63 stores only windows,macos and checks the sorted macos, windows output; it never stores a duplicate, so the test cannot distinguish deduplication from mere sorting.

criteria.criterion: The end-to-end coverage drives vloop run with the platforms problem and portable-check warning and proves it exits 1 before a plan session starts.
criteria.evidence: cmd/vloop/b40_mixed_os_test.go:72-98 asserts exit 1, both exact preflight lines, absent state/runs, unchanged refs, and an unstarted agent marker.

criteria.criterion: This task leaves committed tests covering every worked-example line in the repository's existing test surface, runs on Windows, macOS and Linux without skips or real agents, and the go check runs them.
criteria.evidence: cmd/vloop/b40_mixed_os_test.go is in the existing cmd/vloop test package, has no skip, uses runtime-aware expectations and a Go-built claude stub, and the recorded go check passed cmd/vloop in go.log.

criteria.criterion: No repository without platforms changes doctor, run or plan acceptance behavior except the specified default-shell warning, and the final regression coverage names that violation explicitly.
criteria.evidence: cmd/vloop/b40_mixed_os_test.go:101-130 names TestNoPlatformsRegressionViolationGuard and guards doctor and run from mixed-team findings while checking that driver.GateShapeProblems accepts non-portable verify and .ps1 commands without platforms.

findings.summary: The end-to-end test checks sorted platform messages but never includes a duplicate, so it does not prove the required deduplicated rendering.
